question: The name of the Brahmin priest who later came to be known as Ramakrishna Paramahansa is :
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gadadhar Chattopadhyaya.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ramakrishna Paramahansa** was originally named **Gadadhar Chattopadhyaya.**
 
• He was born in a village called Kamarpukur in the **Hooghly district **of** West Bengal **in **1836.**
 
• Ramakrishna Paramahansa was a **mystic and spiritual teacher **who is considered to be one of the most influential figures in the spiritual history of India.
 
• He was a devotee of the **Hindu goddess Kali **and his teachings were based on the principles of **Advaita Vedanta.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Dayanand Saraswati **was a Hindu reformer who founded the **Arya Samaj.**

 
 
• His greatest work is the book **Satyarth Prakash, **which continues to be a very influential work on the Vedic philosophy and explanations of many concepts and human responsibilities.
 
 
 
• **Shree Narayana Guru** was a** social reformer and philosopher** from Kerala.
 
 
• He spearheaded a reform movement to **advance social equality** and **spiritual enlightenment** by combating injustice in Kerala's caste-based society.
 
• **"One caste, one religion, and one god for all men**" is his well-known quotation.
 
 
 
• **Narendra Nath Datta **was a disciple of Ramakrishna Paramahansa who later became known as **Swami Vivekananda**.
 
 
• He was born on **January 12, 1863, in Calcutta.**
